name: Black Inc
verdict: Black Inc is the carbon component brand of Factor Bikes, which since 2025 is majority-held by VSI Cycling (31.72%) and Zhonglu Co's subsidiary (21.15%). Nothing found.
note: Carbon component (wheel) brand of bike maker Factor Bikes; sleeve sponsor of the 2026 kit. Factor's shareholders (VSI Cycling, Zhonglu Co's subsidiary, CEO Rob Gitelis) are private investors; no state with a human-rights record controls any of them and no human-rights finding against the company found.
